KitCheck RFID Tag System for Crash Carts Medication Scanning

INTRODUCTION/BACKGROUND:

The KitCheck system, from Bluesight technologies, uses a central module that scans RFID tags that are attached to medications within. KitCheck prevents waste, stockouts, and inaccuracies to ensure patient safety, and decreases unnecessary spending by using these RFID tags in the checking process. KitCheck also maximizes staff productivity with significantly faster restocking, recall mitigation, and shortage management of all crash cart trays and kits.

The KitCheck station scans RFID tagged medications and supplies to instantly recognize if product is missing from a tray or kit.  Data can be pulled to identify if medications are expiring or used to locate where recalled medications have been assigned to.
